get.description: Deployment settings the web app needs.

post.description: Stateless helper for the editor's Test pane and validity strip.

delete.description: Hard mode removes the flow and its runs for good; soft mode only hides the flow.

put.description: Saves even an invalid graph (autosave); problems are reported by `validate_flow`.

post.description: Validates the draft, then freezes it as the next numbered version.
Runs inline. A failure or timeout is a 200 "failed"; bad input is 422; too many runs, 429.

get.description: Process is up. Does not check dependencies.
Newest first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.
Step history from the trace store; `pending` while the trace is still being written.
